content: There are numerous studies that identify algorithmic bias in NLP applications. BIBREF2 showed ethnic bias in Google autocomplete suggestions whereas BIBREF3 found gender bias in advertisement delivery systems. Additionally, BIBREF1 demonstrated that coreference resolution systems exhibit gender bias.
